def: to knot or distort; figuratively, to pervert (act or declare perverse)

occurrences.text: He that walketh uprightly walketh surely: but he that perverteth his ways shall be known.
Whoso walketh uprightly shall be saved: but he that is perverse in his ways shall fall at once.
The way of peace they know not; and there is no judgment in their goings: they have made them crooked paths: whosoever goeth therein shall not know peace.
Hear this, I pray you, ye heads of the house of Jacob, and princes of the house of Israel, that abhor judgment, and pervert all equity.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
